[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.39x) — contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — despite neutral RSI, improving MACD, and Higher Low pattern, lack of volume leads to directional ambiguity; maintaining wait-and-see conditions.
